description: Ambiti territoriali ottimali ATO - Servizio Idrico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by accesso.online.alla.risorsa.it. The dataset represents a delimitation of the territory, according to Regional Law No 13 of 20 January 1997, where the public services for the collection, supply and distribution of water for civil use are reorganised, as well as the sewerage and purification of waste water, consisting, as a whole, of the integrated water service referred ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Optimal territorial areas ATO — Water Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
